status: Frozen before new sport evaluation; no metric-driven tuning

model.name: date-batched Elo baseline
model.same_date_policy: Score all games from pre-date ratings; accumulate updates only after the full date batch.

basketball.data: FiveThirtyEight historical NBA Elo game archive; use scores only, not supplied forecasts/ratings.

nfl.data: FiveThirtyEight nfl-elo-game historical match archive; use scores only.

cricket.data: Cricsheet IPL JSON match metadata; no ball-by-ball features.

outcomes: Two outcomes conditional on a decisive winner. Ties/no results excluded and counted; no drawn-game probability or tournament-champion probability implied.
baseline: Constant side-A win frequency fitted on pre-evaluation games only, clipped to [0.01,0.99].
evaluation: Prequential: freeze parameters, score each date before updating with that date outcomes. Report binary log loss, summed two-class Brier, sample size and calibration bins; retain every scored match.
eligibility: No automatic production promotion or superiority claim; report baseline comparison including negative results.
scope: Retrospective public historical replay, not prospective untouched evaluation or current live forecasts. Existing football model and completed temporal decision unchanged.
